name: Belmont University
academic_ranking: Private Christian university in Nashville, TN. Tied #220 of 394 National Universities (U.S. News & World Report 2025-26). Over 130 undergraduate majors across twelve colleges; test-optional. Enrolled students average roughly a 3.83 GPA; overall six-year graduation rate about 71% (IPEDS 2024-25).
financial_aid: Undergraduate tuition and fees approximately $42,540 (2024-25, IPEDS/College Navigator). About 95% of full-time beginning undergraduates receive some form of financial aid and 93% receive grant or scholarship aid (2023-24). Belmont offers institutional academic scholarships in addition to NCAA athletic aid.
facilities_notes: Belmont softball plays at the E.S. Rose Park softball complex in Nashville, TN. No detailed public facilities specifications captured beyond the athletics site.
program_reputation: NCAA Division I program competing in the Missouri Valley Conference (Belmont joined the MVC in Fall 2022, previously the Ohio Valley Conference). The Bruins compete at the D1 level with a full staff led by head coach Laura Matthews.
notes: Data gathered live 2026-07 from belmontbruins.com softball coaches page and roster page, Wikipedia, and NCES College Navigator (IPEDS ID 219709). Emails for the three named coaches were listed on the softball coaches page; the general athletics staff directory showed the same coaches without public emails. No Twitter/X handles listed for any staff. Scholarship count not publicly listed. NCAA D1 softball is allotted up to 12 scholarships but Belmont's specific count is not published.
